BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to increasing the tax on cigarettes; and amending RCW 82.24.026.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 82.24.026 and 2011 c 334 s 1 are each amended to read as follows:Additional tax imposed—Where deposited.
BillSection.P: (1) In addition to the tax imposed upon the sale, use, consumption, handling, possession, or distribution of cigarettes set forth in RCW 82.24.020, there is imposed a tax in an amount equal to three 6.75 cents per cigarette.
Beginning July 1, 2010, (2) The revenue collected under this section must be deposited into the general fund.
